# Yi Cameras with Existing yi-hack Firmware

Retrieve snapshots or bounded streams from Yi cameras already running compatible yi-hack firmware through Muse Home Link, read-only, using the installed fork's enabled HTTP snapshot service or TCP-interleaved RTSP service. The modified community firmware is a use prerequisite that is already installed — this skill never flashes it — and there is no stock-camera access, no camera settings and no arbitrary CGI operations.
